datum.name: R3 robot datum: carpet plane at the frame centre, +X toward the intake, +Y left, millimetres

objectives.objective: AUTO: start with up to eight supported FUEL and score from a legal launch pose while the HUB is active
objectives.basis: Seven stored preloads plus the tracked pocket fit the starting fold (start-capacity premise); launch-wrap and flight cases carry a FUEL into the HUB opening. AUTO route timing stays with the field rehearsal.

objectives.objective: Inactive shift: collect and hold the next allocated stock from the DEPOT, OUTPOST or a partner
objectives.basis: acquire-* cases take a floor FUEL over the bumper into the hopper; hopper-capacity premise checks 24 with the intake deployed.

objectives.objective: Active shift: move loaded and score 24 by the end of the shift (2.00 FUEL/s with stock ready by second 5)
objectives.basis: loaded-transit, index, launch-wrap and flight cases carry one FUEL through the single floor-to-flywheel transfer. The 24-piece rate depends on bulk feeding into two pinch lanes, recorded as open finding F1 with its bench test.

objectives.objective: Fallback: score the available batch when supply or traffic consumes the window and return to collecting
objectives.basis: The cycle is piece-count independent; the intake stays deployed in every operating case.

objectives.objective: Traffic: remain in the own zone, preserve possession during an interrupted crossing and yield
objectives.basis: Loaded-transit keeps stored FUEL inside walls that rise 85 mm above the top-layer centres; retention review R-6.

objectives.objective: Neutral collector alternative with two field crossings
objectives.basis: The coordinator selected the own-zone role. R3 keeps a BUMP crossing option (bump-breakover premise) but its route is not commissioned here.

objectives.objective: End game: Level 1 low-rung hang when its expected 10 points exceed the remaining FUEL service
objectives.basis: tower-lateral, tower-forward, climb-reach, climb-seat (required 2 mm seat contact) and climb-lift raise the robot 70 mm.

objectives.objective: AUTO Level 1 TOWER (15 points, two-robot cap)
objectives.basis: The strategy keeps the eight-FUEL AUTO objective; no joined AUTO climb evidence is sought in this layout.

objectives.objective: Reserve the depot entrance and partner lane
objectives.basis: Alliance routing decision owned by the field rehearsal, independent of the robot layout.

objectives.objective: Measurement: observe intake crossing, retained identity, release and downstream crossing on one timebase
objectives.basis: entry sensor at the front lip and pinch sensor at the flywheel lane are placed; the HUB counter is field equipment.

premises.scenario: Starting configuration with the intake folded
Deployed intake beyond the front frame perimeter
Selected own-zone batch of 24 with the intake deployed
AUTO preload of eight in the starting fold
Delivery pose used by the field rehearsal (about 2.2 m from the HUB centre)
BUMP crest crossing at 530 mm wheelbase needs 71 mm under the belly

mounts.basis: Belt bed rests on the floor pan
Shooter side plates bolt to the rear rail top
Pivot axle bearing on the mount top
Gearmotor flange on the inboard face of the pivot mount
Inner tube runs in bushings in the fixed outer tube
Swing joint on the inner tube top
